plugin.name: Requirements for all parts - read this
plugin.description:
Valhalla A Combat Survival Accord (VaCSA) is one mod installed in parts. Pick only the parts you use on the next pages.
NEEDED BY EVERY PART - Skyrim 1.6.1170 or newer, up to 1.7.104 (tested on 1.7.104). The next page picks the build: "current" for 1.6.1170 and newer, "legacy" for Skyrim SE 1.5.97 and AE before 1.6.1170 (Survival Accord and Valhalla Combat only, NOT tested). Skyrim VR is not covered. The DLLs use Address Library. - SKSE64: https://skse.silverlock.org/ - Address Library for SKSE Plugins: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444 - Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable 2022 (x64), if the game shows a pop-up when it starts.
PART BY PART (each part also lists its own requirements on its page) - Survival (Last Seed / Frostfall): Firmament, Last Seed 2026 and / or Frostfall 2026. - Valhalla Combat 1.7 build: the original Valhalla Combat, Precision, TrueHUD, SKSE Menu Framework. - Archery Locational Damage 1.7 build: the original Archery Locational Damage. - DPF 1.7 build: DPF RE (needed by Parry for All).
Licenses: every license and the source link of every part is installed to Data\Licenses and listed in NOTICE.

plugin.name: Skyrim AE 1.6.1170 or newer, including 1.7.x (tested on 1.7.104)
plugin.description: The current builds. Pick this for Skyrim 1.6.1170, 1.6.1179, 1.7.x and newer (the game version in Skyrim's file properties). Every part is available.

plugin.name: Legacy: Skyrim SE 1.5.97, or AE before 1.6.1170 (NOT tested)
plugin.description:
Legacy builds of Survival Accord and Valhalla Combat for Skyrim SE 1.5.97 and for Anniversary Edition 1.6.x before 1.6.1170. They are built from the same source, but they have NOT been tested on these versions: only 1.7.104 was. Keep a backup of your save.
Archery Locational Damage and the DPF RE DLL have no legacy build: on these versions the original DLLs of those mods already work, so keep them. Skyrim VR is not covered.

group.name: Which survival mods should Survival Accord connect?

plugin.name: Last Seed 2026 - Hunger, Fatigue and Camping
plugin.description:
Replaces Last Seed's Hunger, Fatigue and food-eating scripts with versions that understand Firmament: Pathfinder, Dungeon Delver and Camper slow Hunger and Fatigue, Field Rations makes food restore more Hunger, and Camper lets you sleep Well Rested outdoors. Without Firmament these scripts behave like Last Seed 2026's own.
REQUIRES - Last Seed 2026: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/193833 - Firmament: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/153781 (it needs Constellations https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/117352, Custom Skills Framework https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/41780, Actor Value Generator https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/84743 and SPID https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/36869)
Chosen for you when Last Seed (LastSeed.esp) is in your load order. Install this mod after Last Seed 2026 so its scripts win.

plugin.name: Frostfall 2026 - Cold exposure
plugin.description:
Replaces Frostfall's Exposure script with a version where Firmament's Resilience perk and Fortify Exploration equipment slow the cold Exposure gain. Warming and recovery are not changed. Without Firmament it behaves like Frostfall 2026's own.
REQUIRES - Frostfall 2026: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/193732 - Firmament: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/153781 (and the mods it needs, listed in the Last Seed option above)
Chosen for you when Frostfall (Frostfall.esp) is in your load order. Install this mod after Frostfall 2026 so its script wins.

plugin.name: Valhalla Combat - 1.7 build with Stop On Slash, Elden Counter and Elden Parry built in
plugin.description:
Replaces Valhalla Combat's plugin and DLL with a build that runs on Skyrim 1.7.104 (current build: 1.6.1170 and newer; a legacy build for SE 1.5.97 and AE before 1.6.1170 is installed when you pick it on the version page, NOT tested), and adds three of dTry's mods as built-in features: - Stop On Slash: hit stop and screen shake. - Elden Counter: the guard counter window after a block (the counter animations stay a separate download). - Elden Parry: a bash while an attack lands is a parry; projectiles are deflected. A Parry system setting picks Elden Parry, Parry for All, or off, so two parry systems never fight. Also built in: the Backstab Bug Fix, a light ESL ValhallaCombat.esp (no MCM Helper, no Papyrus), and a settings menu in SKSE Menu Framework (Settings.ini in SKSE\Plugins\ValhallaCombat). Stun defaults are raised so executions trigger on higher difficulties.
REQUIRES (install these first) - Valhalla Combat (main file, for its meshes, sounds and textures): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/64741 - Precision - Accurate Melee Collisions (melee hits on 1.7): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/72347 - TrueHUD - HUD Additions (stun meter): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/62775 - TrueHUD 1.7.99 update, unofficial DLL patch (on Skyrim 1.7): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/189792 - SKSE Menu Framework (the settings page): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/120352
RECOMMENDED - Valhalla Combat AIO Patch (race mapping for modded creatures): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/184932 - Elden Counter (counter animations; do NOT use its DLL): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/65579 (needs Animation Motion Revolution https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/50258, Payload Interpreter https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/65089 and Open Animation Replacer https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/92109) - SHD and 2HM parry animation, for the parry: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/83526 - BFCO Elden Parry Precision Patch, if you use BFCO: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/119938 - BFCO Jump Attack Stamina Cost for Valhalla Combat, if you use BFCO: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/192008 - Parry for All instead of Elden Parry (needs the DPF part below): https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/167873
REMOVE (the new build already contains them) - Valhalla Combat DLL Patch for 1170 / 1799 / 17104 (Nexus 190197) - Valhalla Combat - Backstab Bug Fix (Nexus 97195) - The DLLs of Stop On Slash, Elden Parry and Elden Counter (Nexus 66155, 70240, 65579). Keep the Elden Counter animations and plugin. - Shield of Stamina (Valhalla Combat includes it)
Tested on a save that already used Valhalla Combat. Chosen for you when Valhalla Combat is in your load order.

plugin.name: Archery Locational Damage - 1.7 build
plugin.description:
Replaces Archery Locational Damage's DLL with a build that runs on Skyrim 1.7.104 (built for 1.6.1170 and newer). It fixes the crashes with Firmament's skill use and uses Address Library everywhere. The settings (INI presets) stay Archery Locational Damage's own.
REQUIRES (install this first) - Archery Locational Damage, main file with an INI preset chosen in its installer: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/63863
OPTIONAL - Archery Locational Damage - Realistic Preset: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/140024
Chosen for you when Archery Locational Damage (ArcheryLocationalDamage.esp) is in your load order.

plugin.name: DPF RE - 1.7.104 DLL (for Parry for All)
plugin.description:
Dynamic Persistent Forms REthinked has no DLL for Skyrim 1.7.104, so Parry for All (and anything built on Dynamic Forms Generator) cannot create its forms there. This DLL is a rebuild of the same source for 1.6.1170 and newer (tested on 1.7.104); it replaces DPF.dll and changes nothing else. Skyrim VR and older versions: keep the original DPF.dll.
REQUIRES (install this first) - Dynamic Persistent Forms REthinked - DPF RE: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/183427
NEEDED BY PARRY FOR ALL (only if you use it) - Parry for All: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/167873 - Dynamic Forms Generator: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/182988 - Behavior Data Injector: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/78146 - Notify Events: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/175848 - State Behavior Framework: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/164546 - SKSE Menu Framework: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/120352 Then set Parry system to Parry for All on Valhalla Combat's Parry page, and turn off Valhalla Combat's own Timed Blocking.
Chosen for you when DPF (DPF.esp) is in your load order.
